problem_statement: The Ethernet bridge has no forwarding database (FDB). A bridge currently floods packets it does not recognize to all member interfaces and handles them locally, with no way to bind a specific destination MAC address to a specific member interface so that a packet is forwarded only to that interface. Add FDB table support so that a static MAC-to-interface entry can be registered, and a received frame whose destination MAC matches an FDB entry is forwarded only to the associated interface (and not broadcast to the others, and not handled by the bridge itself).
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/bridge -s tests/net/bridge/net.eth_bridge -s net.eth_bridge -O twister-out --no-clean -W

verification.reason: The statement describes the FDB behavior but omits several public interface details the hidden tests rely on: the Kconfig option, header path, function name/signature, success return value, and header preservation.

problems.detail: The test configuration enables CONFIG_NET_ETHERNET_BRIDGE_FDB, but the problem statement does not name that Kconfig option.
The test includes <zephyr/net/ethernet_bridge_fdb.h>, but the problem statement does not give that public header path.

The test calls eth_bridge_fdb_add() with a MAC address and a net interface, and expects it to return 0 on success, but the statement does not give the function name, signature, or success return value.
The test checks that the forwarded frame's Ethernet header is unchanged, but the statement does not explicitly state that the forwarded frame must preserve the original Ethernet header.

problem_statement_fixed:
The Ethernet bridge has no forwarding database (FDB). A bridge currently floods packets it does not recognize to all member interfaces and handles them locally, with no way to bind a specific destination MAC address to a specific member interface so that a packet is forwarded only to that interface. Add FDB table support so that a static MAC-to-interface entry can be registered, and a received frame whose destination MAC matches an FDB entry is forwarded only to the associated interface (and not broadcast to the others, and not handled by the bridge itself).

The FDB feature shall be controlled by the Kconfig option CONFIG_NET_ETHERNET_BRIDGE_FDB. The public API shall be provided in the header <zephyr/net/ethernet_bridge_fdb.h>. The registration function shall be named eth_bridge_fdb_add, shall accept a pointer to a struct net_eth_addr (the destination MAC address) and a pointer to a struct net_if (the member interface to which the MAC is bound), and shall return 0 on success or a negative errno on failure.
